automation: bun run quality:fitness / bun run quality:fitness:debt
purpose: Project-specific boundaries: src/server/web isolation, forbidden infra imports, undeclared dependencies and shared UI reuse. Structural debt is visible through the debt/strict modes.

automation: bun run quality:architecture / bun run quality:architecture:strict
purpose: dependency-cruiser enforces publishable-library boundaries. The strict variant surfaces existing circular dependencies as ratchet warnings.

automation: bun run typecheck && bun run lint / bun run lint:warnings
purpose: TypeScript strict checks and ESLint errors block merges. lint:warnings exposes legacy style/security warnings as audit debt.

automation: CodeQL workflow and Semgrep project rules
enforcement: Blocking on security findings in CI
purpose: Detects injection, XSS, path traversal, unsafe regex, SSRF-like patterns, weak crypto and other security classes common in AI-generated code.

automation: bun audit, GitHub Dependency Review and OSV-Scanner
purpose: Stops hallucinated, vulnerable or license-incompatible dependencies from entering pull requests.

automation: Gitleaks workflow plus GitHub secret scanning when enabled
purpose: Catches API keys, tokens and provider credentials before merge.

automation: Docker security workflow with Trivy plus supply-chain policy scan
enforcement: Blocking for high/critical image findings; ratchet warnings for floating tags and curl-pipe-shell
purpose: Protects GPU images, Dockerfiles and deployment scripts from vulnerable bases and unsafe install patterns.

automation: bun run quality:deadcode / bun run quality:deadcode:strict
enforcement: Manual/audit ratchet until current debt is triaged
purpose: Knip finds unused files, exports and dependencies so AI-generated scaffolding does not accumulate silently.

enforcement: Available as a focused gate for high-risk pure logic
purpose: fast-check generates many edge cases for invariants in routing, compatibility, parsing, cache keys and state machines.
Stryker verifies whether tests actually fail when behavior changes, instead of trusting coverage alone.

automation: Existing contract unit tests plus planned OpenAPI/Pact gate
enforcement: Unit gate today; OpenAPI/Pact can become blocking after specs are generated
purpose: Prevents SDK, HTTP routes and WebSocket payload expectations from drifting across Gateway clients and server handlers.

enforcement: Blocking in quality:ai for hard failures; warnings ratcheted with --strict
purpose: Audits GitHub Actions permissions, action pinning, floating refs, Docker latest tags and unsafe shell installers.

automation: GitHub artifact attestations and SBOM upload in release workflows
purpose: Creates verifiable build provenance for published artifacts and Docker images.
